name: trd_mig
description: Migrate TRD data for a product: optional truncate (profile or own tables), empty-table check, the country's SQL file, and a final row count.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: connection
arguments.description: Oracle connection with IP, PORT (1-65535) and SID.

arguments.name: credentials
arguments.description: Schema credentials: an object (or a JSON string of one) with username and password.

arguments.name: country
arguments.description: Country key from the mapping's 'countries'; selects the SQL file run (from the sqls folder) and the database link substituted for {dblink} (case-insensitive).

arguments.name: product
arguments.description: Product key from the mapping's 'products' (for example app1, app2, app3); selects the count table and, when the country maps one file per product, the SQL file (case-insensitive).

arguments.name: truncate
arguments.description: Truncate tables before the insert; the truncate step is skipped when false.

arguments.name: truncate_profile
arguments.description: Name of the mapping 'truncate_profiles' entry whose tables are truncated when truncate is true.

arguments.name: truncate_tables
arguments.description: Own list of tables to truncate; overrides truncate_profile.

arguments.name: mapping
arguments.description: Mapping JSON with 'truncate_profiles', 'countries' (dblink and sql file, or sql file per product) and 'products' (count_table); SQL files are read from the sqls folder next to it. Defaults to the plugin's mapping.json.

arguments.name: sqlhome
arguments.description: Oracle home whose bin/sqlplus is used; sqlplus is taken from PATH when omitted.

outputs.name: sql_file
outputs.description: SQL file run, relative to the sqls folder.

outputs.name: truncated
outputs.description: Tables truncated (empty when truncate was skipped).

outputs.name: count_before
outputs.description: Row count of count_table before the insert.

outputs.name: count_after
outputs.description: Row count of count_table after the insert.

outputs.name: counts
outputs.description: Row count after the insert, keyed by product.
